headlines.title: ETFs Are Net Sellers of Netflix (NFLX) on Tuesday
headlines.summary: ETFs sold a net $13.1 million of Netflix (NFLX) on Nov. 3, with 13 sellers against 35 buyers.

headlines.title: Bill Ackman: Netflix “an Incredibly Cheap Stock” After a 55% Drop. But Is He Right?
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysBill Ackman called Netflix “an incredibly cheap stock” on CNBC’s Squawk Pod, after his fund sold out of most of its Alphabet stake and with Netflix down about 55% from its June 2025 high. Ackman says viewing hours are falling because Netflix’s content mix is changing, and Netflix’s churn improved year over year in the third quarter.

headlines.title: Netflix Is Playing a Bigger Game. Investors Should Take Notice
headlines.summary: Netflix posted record profits, bought back nearly $5 billion of its own stock, and signed deals with Disney and the NFL, yet shares sit just above a 52-week low. Something about that gap deserves a closer look.

headlines.title: Netflix, Inc. (NFLX) Continues to Defy Expectations: Is There Still Upside Ahead?
headlines.summary: Pershing Square Inc. recently released its Q3 2026 investor letter. A copy of the letter can be downloaded here. The letter reported 13% year-over-year growth in third-quarter fee-related earnings (FRE) to $63.7 million, while distributable earnings (DE) before taxes increased 8% to $61.0 million. After taxes, DE totaled $49.5 million, or $0.

headlines.title: Netflix Trades at a Discount to the S&P 500's Valuation. Is It Deserved?
headlines.summary: Netflix is now trading for less than 17 times next year's earnings.

description: Netflix, Inc. provides entertainment services worldwide. The company offers television (TV) series, documentaries, feature films, games, and live programming across various genres and languages. It also provides members the ability to receive streaming content through a host of internet-connected devices, including TVs, digital video players, TV set-top boxes, and mobile devices. Netflix, Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, California.
